title: Review finding
description: One JSON object per line in the findings log. One vocabulary, so results across runs can be counted -- which is what turns review from opinion into evidence.

id.description: Unique within the run, e.g. f-3465-07.

run.description: Shared by every finding from one review, keyed by the reviewed tree: run-<tree12>.

round.description: Fix-loop iteration. A second pass is a second round of one review, not a second review.

type.description: 'run' marks the clean-pass record written when a review finds nothing.

pr.description: PR number if the review ran against one.

tree.description: The reviewed tree. Absent when gateable is false.

gateable.description: False for unstaged workspace reviews: the index tree is not what was reviewed, so a commit gate must not accept it.

range.description: The diff range the run selected.

lane.description: Which lane produced it. Lanes fan out over the work, not over personas.

rule.description: Rule id, e.g. CA-6, T-2, C-3, D-8.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the subject file.

line.description: DERIVED by matching anchor against the file's added lines -- never asserted directly.

anchor.description: Verbatim added lines the finding refers to, leading + stripped. Line numbers hallucinate; quoted code does not.

unanchored.description: Set when the anchor matched zero or several times. Such a finding is re-located, never attached to a guessed line.

effort.description: The axis nobody copies and the most useful of the three: severity says whether a finding is real, effort says whether it is worth doing now.

scope.description: pre-existing is a label, never a downgrade -- and requires the change to have made that code newly wrong or load-bearing.

claim.description: One sentence: what breaks, and when.

evidence.description: Commands run and what they returned. Required for critical and major -- those are rejected at record time without it.

outcome.description: Set after the fix loop. This is what makes precision measurable.
